description: This file defines the TransactionalResource<TState> class implementing ITransactionalResource, managing transactional state operations such as commit, abort, cancel, confirm, and prepare within Orleans transaction system.

classes.name: TransactionalResource<TState>
classes.description: A class managing transactional operations on a resource state, supporting commit, abort, cancel, confirm, and prepare actions within Orleans transactions.

methods.name: CommitReadOnly
methods.description: Handles the commit operation for a read-only transaction, validating the lock, updating the record, and notifying relevant parties.

methods.name: Abort
methods.description: Handles aborting a transaction, releasing locks and preparing the resource state accordingly.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels a transaction, notifying the system of the cancellation.

methods.name: Confirm
methods.description: Confirms a transaction, updating the state accordingly.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares the resource for a transaction, possibly involving participant coordination.
